summary.intent: Run all P1 scenarios against the Conduit app locally during a hackathon, and gather evidence and submission material (build log, README accuracy, Entire dispatch, neatlogs detections, X post drafts).
summary.outcome: The scenario validation fix and a build log entry were committed, and the P1 run started and was progressing. The README was reviewed, X post drafts were written, and a second repo (kutt) analysis was started in parallel. The neatlogs detection preview stayed unavailable, and final analysis results were still pending.

repo: The app starts in about 1 minute (Postgres, .env, API, frontend) before scenarios run.
The hackathon build log (hackathon.md) is kept as evidence and updated with entries such as failure-recovery.
The README contains figures that may be out of date and need updating after the P1 run finishes.
`entire dispatch` summarizes the latest agent run and can serve as hackathon evidence.
workflow: Use a wait loop in the background to be notified when a long run ends or fails, instead of polling.
Do independent work (README review, drafting posts, analyzing a second repo) while a long run is in progress.
Commit small fixes and build log entries separately.

friction: The neatlogs preview_detection service was unresponsive across several attempts.
open_items: Update the README analysis figures once the P1 run finishes.
Regenerate the full Entire dispatch at the end of the hackathon and save it as evidence.
Retry neatlogs detection preview and list_detections once the service is back.
Finish and review the kutt analysis.
Finalize and publish the X post drafts.
